P088.evidence_section: Methods / Locus definitions, variant annotation and gene prioritization / Polygenic priority score
P088.use_summary: Computed PoPS for 18,383 genes using the full provided features and MAGMA 1.10 gene results based on European 1000 Genomes Phase 3 LD. Locus and genome-wide PoPS ranks then contributed separately weighted components to an omnibus cardiomyopathy gene-prioritization score.
P088.evidence_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11631763/ (section: Methods / Locus definitions, variant annotation and gene prioritization / Polygenic priority score)
P088.implementation_scope_note: The author commit, complete commands and numerical controls are not identified. MAGMA, biological reference-panel construction, locus windows, top-three/top-200 scoring and the omnibus prioritization model are distinct steps. Native PoPS 0.2 ridge/OLS and the explicit original-edition adapter provide prepared-input estimation; this is not identification of the author commit/options or a whole-paper reproduction.

P090.use_summary: Computed PoPS v0.1 gene-feature enrichment scores. Top-three genes at each locus helped define initial candidates, followed by eight equally weighted sources of evidence. Tied final scores did not yield a single high-confidence gene.
P090.implementation_scope_note: Legacy v0.1 has separate feature-selection and chromosome-held-out prediction programs. The v0.2 native kernel is not a v0.1 substitute. Exact author source, complete feature/LD settings and downstream combined evidence are unresolved. Native PoPS 0.2 ridge/OLS and the explicit original-edition adapter provide prepared-input estimation; this is not identification of the author commit/options or a whole-paper reproduction.

P120.use_summary: Used PoPS to map hypothyroidism loci through MAGMA gene associations/correlations from European 1000 Genomes LD and gene-feature enrichment over more than 50,000 features. Genes in the top score decile were prioritized. Code availability explicitly lists PoPS v0.2.
P120.implementation_scope_note: The exact commit, commands, reference preparation and decile tie policy are not reported here. Do not treat project defaults or a native regression control as the author analysis. Native PoPS 0.2 ridge/OLS and the explicit original-edition adapter provide prepared-input estimation; this is not identification of the author commit/options or a whole-paper reproduction.

P153.use_summary: Benchmarked enhancer-to-gene predictions by intersecting the two highest model-ranked genes with the two highest PoPS-ranked genes per credible set. PoPS ranks were also displayed for genes near the lymphocyte-count variant rs7696969.
P153.implementation_scope_note: The excerpt establishes ranking/intersection use; it does not establish a fresh PoPS fit, version, author binary or upstream score provenance. Credible-set construction and model ranking are separate. This observation concerns reported score use. It does not authorize inferring a new PoPS fit, version or default method; source score releases and downstream comparison/enrichment require their own provenance.

P220.evidence_section: Material and methods / Common-variant gene prioritization scores
P220.use_summary: Downloaded published PoPS gene scores for BMI, waist-to-hip ratio adjusted for BMI and body-fat percentage from FinucaneLab. Compared score enrichment between genes with significant rare-variant associations and other genes.
P220.evidence_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12696503/ (section: Material and methods / Common-variant gene prioritization scores)
P220.implementation_scope_note: This is reuse of published scores, not a PoPS estimator run. Score release identity, the three trait mappings and downstream one-sided t tests must be recorded independently. This observation concerns reported score use. It does not authorize inferring a new PoPS fit, version or default method; source score releases and downstream comparison/enrichment require their own provenance.
